name: Form D
what: The SEC notice of an exempt offering under Regulation D or Section 4(a)(5), filed on EDGAR and public once accepted.

fields.label: Name of issuer
fields.definition: The legal entity issuing the securities.

fields.label: Entity type
fields.definition: Corporation, limited partnership, limited liability company, general partnership, business trust, other, or yet to be formed.

fields.label: Related persons
fields.definition: Executive officers, directors, people in similar roles such as managing members or general partners, and promoters.

fields.label: Industry group
fields.definition: The group that fits the use of the bulk of the proceeds; real estate choices are Commercial, Construction, REITS & Finance, Residential and Other Real Estate.

fields.label: Issuer size
fields.definition: A revenue range, or an aggregate net asset value range for issuers that pick Hedge Fund or Other Investment Fund; either may be declined.

fields.label: Exemptions and exclusions claimed
fields.definition: Rule 504 or 506 paragraphs, Section 4(a)(5), and any Investment Company Act Section 3(c) exclusion.

fields.label: Date of first sale
fields.definition: The date the first investor is irrevocably contractually committed to invest, or 'yet to occur'.

fields.label: Offering lasts more than one year
fields.definition: Whether the issuer intends the offering to last more than one year.

fields.label: Types of securities offered
fields.definition: Equity, debt, options or rights, pooled investment fund interests, tenant-in-common securities, mineral property securities or other.

fields.label: Minimum investment
fields.definition: The minimum accepted from an outside investor; if it can be waived, the lowest amount below which no waiver is granted; 0 if none.

fields.label: Sales compensation recipients
fields.definition: Each person paid to sell, including finders, with CRD numbers where they exist and the states solicited.

fields.label: Total offering amount
fields.definition: The amount offered under the claimed exemption, including cash due later under mandatory capital commitments, or indefinite.

fields.label: Total amount sold
fields.definition: The amount sold as of the filing date, counted from the start of the offering.

fields.label: Non-accredited investors
fields.definition: The number of investors who are not accredited and have already invested.

fields.label: Total investors
fields.definition: Everyone who has invested to date, whether or not they still hold.

fields.label: Proceeds paid to related persons
fields.definition: Gross proceeds used or proposed for payments to anyone named in Item 3.
